task.title: Read a run
task.shortdesc: A run shows the set's results in a band, then each topic: its checks, the draft beside the published topic, the DITA XML and the report a writer sees on the pull request.

info.p: It gives the model, the time to draft the set, grammar failures that reached a writer, the share of values with a key or a source, the mean edit ratio, the open questions and the logged cost.
The tab shows the topic's edit ratio, or stub · no sibling for a topic that is new in the generation.
Grammar, Rules and Grounding are the gates. Built from names the sibling topics. Safe fixes, when shown, are changes code made without asking the model again.

step.cmd: Compare the draft with the published topic.

info.p: Questions show as dashed boxes in the draft. A published topic never shows them, because DITA processors hide draft comments.

step.cmd: Expand DITA XML of the draft to see the key references and draft comments, or Checks on each attempt to see what failed before a revision.
